bio.text: Lori McCann is a Republican who represents District 6 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a third term.
According to the legislature's biography, she has lived in Lewiston for over 50 years and graduated from Lewiston High School and the University of Idaho with a B.S. in education.
It says she was a program coordinator and professor in the paralegal and legal assisting programs at Lewis-Clark State College for more than 15 years.
It also says she served on the Tammany School Board and is a past president of the Idaho Association for Legal Professionals.
